name: Crossroads Community Services
hoursNotes: All visits by appointment. Also 1st Saturday 9am–1pm and 4th Thursday 1:30–5:30pm.
requirements: Appointment required (call 469-860-6090). Income must fall below TEFAP guidelines but no proof of income is required. Serves specific southern Dallas County ZIP codes.
notes: Shopper-choice Community Market; a family of four receives roughly 100 lbs of groceries per monthly visit.
